$comment: Owner sign-offs for the AGENT-SAFETY META-GAUNTLET (the raccoon rule). A weakening of the gauntlet's own rigor standards is permitted ONLY via an explicit, owner-signed entry here. Each sign-off names the exact live element being weakened, the weakening class it authorizes, the owner, a justification, and an expiry. Expired, stale, cured, unmatched, placeholder-bearing, and always-blocking weakenings are not retained as governed exceptions. Entries are reconciled against the live standards diff; obsolete approvals are removed rather than preserved as historical sediment.

signoffs.justification: Sanctioned capability-gated skip (the loaded Rust WASM kernel). describe.skipIf(!wasmPresent) — the WASM/TS kernel parity arm BODY runs when the Rust kernel IS loaded (compares liteship-compute against fallbackKernels). A runtime capability gate, not a placeholder. Enumerated in SANCTIONED_SKIPS at site granularity; signed vs the snapshot's birth baseline (the bootstrap window).

Sanctioned capability-gated skip (the staged @liteship/core dist wasm artifact). it.skipIf(!staged) — the module-graph resolution of @liteship/core dist/liteship-compute.wasm BODY runs only when the built artifact is staged (a publish-shape probe). A runtime capability gate, not a placeholder. Enumerated in SANCTIONED_SKIPS at site granularity; signed vs the snapshot's birth baseline (the bootstrap window).

Sanctioned capability-gated skip (capability running-as-root: root ignores file-mode write denial). it.skipIf(runningAsRoot) — the chmod-0o444 restore-failure proof BODY runs on every non-root process (Windows read-only attributes included; running-as-root is deliberately narrower than eacces-untestable-as-root, which also reads true on Windows where the proof WORKS — the capability-link oracle requires the guard to derive from its OWN capability's probe, so the narrower predicate is a first-class capability). Under root the mode denies nothing and the test would hit expect.unreachable (PR #192 review round 4, confirmed). The contract keeps root-independent executable coverage via the fs-mock restore-write-denial law in mutation-runner-restore-verify.test.ts. A runtime capability gate, not a placeholder. Enumerated in SANCTIONED_SKIPS at site granularity.
